name: forge-monorepo
description: Durable, project-scoped memory and semantic retrieval for AI agents and developer tools.

scripts.build: npm run build -w forge-persistence-gateway && npm run build -w forge-embedding-worker && npm run build -w forge-mcp-server && npm run build -w forge-semantic-bridge && npm run build -w forge-resilience && npm run build -w forge-workbench
scripts.test: npm test -w forge-postgresql-schema && npm test -w forge-persistence-gateway && npm test -w forge-embedding-worker && npm test -w forge-mcp-server && npm test -w forge-semantic-bridge && npm test -w forge-resilience && npm test -w forge-workbench
scripts.check: npm run check:deployment && npm run check:notices && npm run build && npm test
